As the final checkpoint before shipment, the Transportation Loader verifies load readiness, product quality, staging accuracy, and order add-ons to ensure accurate deliveries to community partners. Essential Duties & Responsibilities Follow all food safety, quality assurance, and workplace safety standards. Prepare and stage all outbound loads prior to driver arrival. Ensure all pallets are properly wrapped, labeled, organized, and ready for loading. Verify staged loads have been checked for accuracy and product quality. Understand the facility’s staging process and ensure staging lanes remain organized and operational. Assist with reorganizing staged product as routes or priorities change. Proactively prepare second- and third-leg deliveries to minimize driver downtime during reloads. Identify and communicate any product quality concerns, shortages, damages, or loading issues immediately. Assist in loading delivery vehicles using an electric pallet jack while following all safety procedures. Maintain continuous communication with the Transportation Supervisor and drivers regarding route readiness and timing. Support warehouse and transportation operations during peak periods as assigned. Qualifications Qualifications Previous warehouse, shipping, transportation, or distribution experience preferred. Experience operating an electric pallet jack or willingness to become certified. Ability to communicate effectively with drivers, supervisors, and warehouse staff. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced environment. Understanding of warehouse safety practices. Value-aligned in our mission to end hunger. Physical Requirements Ability to stand and walk for up to 8 hours per shift. Frequently push, pull, and maneuver loaded pallets using an electric pallet jack. Ability to lift up to 60 pounds. Ability to bend, twist, reach, and stack packaged goods. Ability to work in dry, refrigerated, and freezer warehouse environments. Success in This Role A successful Transportation Loader consistently ensures that: Drivers arrive to fully staged, accurate, and quality-checked loads. Second- and third-leg deliveries are prepared before drivers return for reloads. Driver warehouse dwell time is minimized. Staging areas remain clean, organized, and operational throughout the day. Product quality concerns are identified before deliveries leave the facility. Communication with drivers and management is proactive, resulting in smooth daily transportation operations. This role directly supports operational efficiency by reducing route delays, improving driver productivity, and ensuring timely, accurate deliveries to partners. Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance coverage Employer-paid life and disability insurance Employee Assistance Program 403(b) retirement plan with employer contribution Generous Paid Time Off Parental Leave On-site Gym $3,000 annual employer -paid ThrivePass lifestyle and wellness benefit program $250 employee referral bonus

review_candidates.title: Senior Technical Specialist
review_candidates.description: Career Opportunity: Senior Technical Specialist Prime focus of position The Senior Technical Specialist is responsible for leading and overseeing advanced regulatory and technical projects within the electronic communications domain. The role involves ensuring compliance with regulations, shaping policy development, conducting high-level technical research, and representing the Authority at the national and international levels. The Senior Technical Specialist will act as a mentor to junior staff and provide strategic guidance on regulatory and technical challenges. Main Responsibilities Direct Accountability Lead and oversee the management of the radio spectrum in compliance with national and European law. Develop and drive consultation documents, high-level technical reports, and policy or strategy documents related to electronic communications regulation. Supervise and provide guidance on investigations and compliance monitoring of operators and service providers, ensuring adherence to obligations such as interference, electromagnetic radiation, quality of service, and security. Validate notifications related to electronic communications networks, radiocommunications equipment, and spectrum assignments. Direct and manage surveys and mapping of electronic communications infrastructure, service coverage, demand, investment, and funding opportunities. Conduct and oversee strategic research on socio-economic drivers for connectivity, leading assessments of demand, investment trends, and funding opportunities. Evaluate emerging technological advancements in the electronic communications domain and propose strategic initiatives for Malta. Represent MCA at national and international regulatory and industry forums, providing expert leadership and technical input. Advise senior executives and decision-makers within MCA on technical, regulatory, and strategic matters. Develop technical regulatory frameworks and contribute to legislative updates and amendments. Engage in high-level technical liaison with governmental and industry stakeholders. Perform other high-level duties as assigned by the Chief of Spectrum Management and Technology. Management Oversee and manage complex projects independently, ensuring alignment with regulatory objectives. Lead the business planning process by defining technical strategies and objectives. Identify, develop, and implement innovative regulatory solutions and frameworks. Ensure compliance with international best practices and regulatory requirements. Mentor and coach junior and mid-level specialists, ensuring knowledge transfer and professional development. Internal Contacts Provide technical expertise within the MCA, guiding internal teams and management. Support executive leadership by providing strategic technical insights and regulatory direction. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop integrated regulatory strategies. Recommend policy adjustments based on advanced research findings and technological developments. External Contacts Engage with high-level stakeholders, including government agencies, international regulators, and industry leaders. Represent the MCA in critical discussions at the national, EU, and international levels, including within BEREC, the RSPG, CEPT and the ITU. Provide advisory and technical expertise to external entities on regulatory compliance and emerging technologies. Lead and contribute to intergovernmental and cross-industry working groups. Key Selection Criteria Qualifications & Experience A recognized qualification at MQF Level 7 in a Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) discipline, or equivalent with a minimum of three (3) years of experience in a relevant field. OR a recognized qualification at MQF Level 6 with at least four (4) years of relevant experience. Competencies & Skills Strong analytical, leadership, and strategic decision-making skills. Expert-level report writing and technical documentation skills. Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to engage at senior levels in the English and Maltese languages. Advanced proficiency in regulatory analysis, risk assessment, and technical compliance. Proficiency in office automation tools, data analysis software, and technical modeling tools. Ability to work independently and lead strategic initiatives. Preferred Qualifications & Experience Extensive expertise in areas such as spectrum management, data communications, cybersecurity, electromagnetics, geographical surveys, GIS, and qualitative or quantitative research methods. Project management certification (e.g., PRINCE2, PMP) and proven experience in managing regulatory projects. Significant experience in the telecommunications sector, regulatory enforcement, or policy development. Experience in representing regulatory authorities at international and governmental levels. Additional Notes *A recognized Qualification comparable to the number of credits, as applicable, is only accepted subject to an MQRIC formal recognition statement.* By the closing time and date of this call for applications, applicants must be: citizens of Malta; or citizens of other Member States of the European Union who are entitled to equal treatment to Maltese citizens in matters of employment by virtue of EU legislation and treaty provisions dealing with the free movement of workers; or citizens of any other country who are entitled to equal treatment to Maltese citizens in matters related to employment by virtue of the application to that country of EU legislation and treaty provisions dealing with the free movement of workers; or any other persons who are entitled to equal treatment to Maltese citizens in matters related to employment in terms of the law or the above-mentioned EU legislation and treaty provisions, on account of their family relationship with persons mentioned in paragraph (1), (2) or (3); or third country nationals who have been granted long-term resident status in Malta under regulation 4 of the ‘Status of Long-Term Residents (Third Country Nationals) Regulations, 2006’ or who have been granted a residence permit under regulation 18(3) thereof, together with family members of such third country nationals who have been granted a residence permit under the ‘Family Reunification Regulations, 2007’; or in possession of a residence document issued in terms of the “Residence Status of United Kingdom Nationals and their Family Members in Malta in accordance with the Agreement on the Withdrawal of the United Kingdom and Northern Ireland from the European Union and the European Atomic Energy Community Regulations”. review_candidates.title: Media Relations Manager
review_candidates.description: About The One Campaign ONE is a global, nonpartisan organization fighting for a more just world by demanding the investments needed to create economic opportunities and healthier lives in Africa. We do this by deploying trusted and dynamic advocacy that leverages hard-hitting data, credible grassroots activism, creative political engagement, and strategic partnerships. We use all this to influence decision-makers to take action and tackle the world’s biggest challenges. Read more at www.one.org. About The Role The Media Relations Manager will help ONE achieve its policy-changing objectives through media engagement with priority media outlets across North America, with special emphasis in the US. They will play a key role in developing new communications products and approaches and coordinating compelling narratives around priority issues for use by all the teams across North America. They will also work with staff in similar roles across the organization. The Manager will have a solid understanding of how proactive media engagement can bring about policy change, demonstrable experience of engaging media in the US and Canada, and the ability to concisely and persuasively communicate complex issues. There will be exposure to managing events, publications, and communications products. They will lead on the development and execution of the media strategy under the direction and guidance from the Director of Communications, North America. They will play a collaborative role in integrating full spectrum communications strategies and tactics within the NA team. As appropriate, they will coordinate with ONE’s communications staff around the world. In This Role You Will Serve as one of the primary media liaisons for ONE in the United States and Canada. Build and maintain positive working relationships with elite media, reporters, and partners; pitch coverage of ONE, our narratives and priorities to North American print, broadcast, and online media outlets. Secure media coverage for ONE’s issues in outlets with a primary emphasis on Tier 1 and 2 media in the US and Canada. Supporting ONE staff around key milestones and events. Monitor news and industry associations for trends, best practices, and emerging issues to inform organizational strategy to respond, capitalize or generate own content. Ensuring ONE staff have access to media content as well as mentions, maintaining an internal database of outlets and access accounts. Produce and review media relations products, and assist with full spectrum communications products, including: press releases, op-eds, opportunities to profile NA leadership, website content, video and website content, and other messaging materials. Assist in developing and executing social media strategies on ONE in America and ONE in Canada market channels. Collaborate with the North America teams to execute ONE’s North America strategy as set by the Executive Director and North America Leadership Team. Craft narratives and support for campaigns, government relations, and policy activities. Advise on communications and media strategies for the North America Advocacy team, contributing to the formation and execution of political and policy strategies. Promote, enhance, and protect ONE’s reputation in North America, overseeing strategies to reinforce and defend ONE’s credibility and strengthen ONE’s global brand and position as an advocacy organization. Contribute the global communications community of practice. Share best practices, strategies, messaging, and products to ensure ONE’s positions are communicated and integrated effectively across departments and regions. Other duties as assigned by the Director of Communications, North America. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU: Bachelor’s degree in communications, public relations, journalism, marketing, or a related A master’s degree is preferred but not required. 8+ years of experience in media, public relations, or journalism, plus 3+ years’ experience managing a team or in a project-lead capacity. Proven ability to leverage media relations in order to deliver policy change. Established network of relationships with key journalists and media, including but not limited to the Associated Press, Reuters, and other Tier 1 outlets. Ability to synthesize complicated policy issues into digestible products. Experience with both elite and popular media, as well as specialist and non-specialist audiences. Excellent track record of developing and delivering effective media strategies. Significant experience speaking on the record. Significant experience of risk and reputation management, and crisis communications. A thorough understanding of the evolving media landscape and the requirements of different kinds of modern media. Significant experience working with the political media in North America. A strong understanding of the links between policy, advocacy, campaigning, and media work. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, fluency in French is an asset. Excellent time management, forward-planning, and prioritization skills. Proven ability to work effectively in a team environment and strong interpersonal skills. Advanced leadership skills, critical thinking and problem solving. High proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Suite. Ability to live and work in the United States, and legal authority to travel to Canada, is required. OTHER ATTRIBUTES: Related work history in poverty and infectious disease alleviation, advocacy, policy, legislation and/or demonstrable interest in Africa and the issues ONE supports is an asset. Ability to maintain the highest degree of confidentiality regarding all aspects of work at all times. Ability to work proactively in a collaborative and distributed environment, manage multiple, shifting priorities under tight deadlines while performing in a fast- paced, team-oriented environment. Collaborative mindset and strong interpersonal skills. Critical thinking, communication, and relationship-building skills. Analytical, action-oriented, and results focused. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-motivated. Remain positive in high pressure and stressful situations. Consistent application of good judgment, and ability to make good and responsible decisions. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: $75,000 - $100,000 annual salary. This salary range is based on compensation survey data for similar organizations and is used to set pay internally at ONE. Where a new hire’s salary falls within this range is based on a variety of factors, including the budget available for this position. review_candidates.description: About Gusto At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve. All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy. AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process. About Design At Gusto Design at Gusto is made up of over 80 creative, collaborative people who care deeply about our mission to empower small businesses and their employees. We're a cross-functional group that is always looking for opportunities to build understanding and empathy for the people who use Gusto. We don't care much about swim lanes and though we care deeply about quality and craft, we are never precious about it. We work closely with cross-functional partners in Product, Engineering, Data, and Marketing to design, build, and ship experiences that make a real difference. We are building an AI-native design organization — and we mean that seriously. We're looking for designers who are already working this way: using AI to prototype ideas quickly, shorten customer feedback loops, and ship quality UX directly to customers. About The Role Gusto's Growth team owns the full customer funnel — from a small business's first visit to gusto.com through onboarding and into ongoing expansion. Two of the most complex, cross-cutting systems inside that funnel are how we price and package our products, and how we orchestrate the messages customers get across email, sales, and in-product surfaces. Neither has ever had dedicated, systems-level design support until now. This role is leveled at the equivalent to a Staff-level. As Product Designer in this scope, you'll own the design system for how promotions, tiers, and SKUs are presented consistently across the funnel, including a unified checkout experience, and drive the next wave of iteration following our fall pricing & packaging refresh. Alongside that, you'll partner closely with our Revenue Systems team to define the target-state UX vision for customer-centric orchestration: establishing how a customer experiences one coordinated set of communications across email, sales, and in-product/AI surfaces, rather than a patchwork of independent touchpoints, and drawing the line between what belongs at the platform level versus the channel level. You'll round this out with lighter-touch, ongoing design support for Invoicing & Billing as needs arise, including near-term work like multi-entity billing. This is a systems-thinking role, with direct impact on revenue generation. You'll need to be as comfortable zooming out to define a multi-team experience architecture as you are zooming in to get the details of a specific surface right, and you'll need a strong customer experience and business sensibility to match. About The Team Gusto's Growth team is dedicated to helping customers discover, adopt, and expand into the Gusto ecosystem in meaningful ways. You'll be joining a collaborative, cross-functional team of designers, engineers, PMs, data scientists, and key business partners who care deeply about customer experience — and who operate at the intersection of product-led growth, marketing, and sales. In this role, you'll work closely with partners across Growth & Commerce, Revenue Systems, Sales, Marketing, and BizTech, while serving as the lead designer across several interrelated surfaces and systems. Here's What You'll Do Day-to-day Design dynamic pricing and packaging displays that span the funnel—from acquisition through activation and billing to ensure that buyers will quickly and confidently purchase Gusto products. Design across Gusto's invoicing and billing surfaces, building on the recently rebuilt IBEX platform Build and improve internal tools such as the Promo Engine and Product Catalog, and improve existing workflows in Gusto's internal platforms, to enable self-service and better outcomes for internal teams across Growth, Marketing, Accounting, Sales, and Expansion Sales. Partner with Revenue Systems to define the target-state UX vision for multi-channel messaging orchestration—establishing systems cohesion across email, sales, and in-product/AI surfaces, and standardizing how AI-driven messaging is structured, sequenced, and represented to customers. Draw the line between what belongs at the platform level versus the channel level (e.g., AI Email, Rec Center, Gus) so each surface stops solving the same problems separately. Drive holistic service design, connecting the dots between how internal teams support customer decisions and how customers experience pricing, billing, and messaging throughout their journey. Collaborate deeply with cross-functional partners to align on strategy, lead workshops, and co-create end-to-end solutions across multiple surfaces. Create scalable, consistent patterns by working with and contributing to Gusto's design system to ensure alignment across internal and external experiences. Use a mix of data and qualitative insights to validate decisions, inform tradeoffs, and refine designs over time through iteration. Here's What We're Looking For 8+ years of product design experience with a strong portfolio of systems-level design, internal tooling, and customer-facing product surfaces. Experience working on complex, data-rich products—particularly in B2B SaaS environments with interconnected product offerings. Demonstrated success in designing for both internal users and external customers, and the ability to balance their competing needs. Fluency in UX best practices, UI design, interaction design, and accessibility standards. Strong service design capabilities and a proven ability to map and simplify complex systems across touchpoints and orgs. Experience designing for multi-channel systems cohesion—unifying messaging, sequencing, and experience across email, sales, and in-product/AI surfaces—and a point of view on standardizing AI-driven messaging at scale. Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to lead through influence and align cross-functional teams. Comfort leading ambiguous, 0-to-1 work, and building long-term vision while executing toward near-term milestones. Experience using tools like Figma, Amplitude, and FullStory—and in leveraging mixed-methods research to inform design. Passion for empowering internal teams and improving the quality of internal systems through intuitive, scalable design. Our cash compensation range for this role is $147,000/yr to $183,000/yr in Denver, and $177,000/yr to $222,000/yr in San Francisco and New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above. Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). Ability to work proactively in a collaborative and distributed environment, manage multiple, shifting priorities under tight deadlines while performing in a fast- paced, team-oriented environment. Collaborative mindset and strong interpersonal skills. Critical thinking, communication, and relationship-building skills. Analytical, action-oriented, and results focused. Consistent application of good judgment, and ability to make good and responsible decisions. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: $75,000 - $100,000 annual salary.
